title: The Actor and the Actress
label: ch:actor-actriz
canDo: I can name the actor and the actress, say why the feminine is actriz rather than actora, and ask who is in a film rather than only what the film is.

payoff.summary: Ask who is in the film and answer with a person rather than a thing, choosing the article from the person's gender and not from the word's ending.
payoff.note: These two words close A1-NE18-06 (cinema and theatre). The point was left open on purpose in chapter 420: cine, pelicula and teatro were already taught, and wiring the probe on those three while actor and actriz were absent would have repeated the over-claim a review blocked on A1-NE06-05. The chapter carries a review lesson and a synthesis lesson after the two word lessons, budgeted rather than discovered, because the last atom introduced in a track has nowhere to be retrieved and the reinforcement criterion then falls short.
